subject: Pipe LiftPlaybook: stage refresh, coverage gap & finance check-in
messages:
From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pipe LiftPlaybook: stage refresh, coverage gap & finance check-in

Team —

Quick note to lock a short cadence on NX deal coverage. Attached is a snapshot (pipe by stage + expected close months) and a one‑page microcommit playbook I sketched. Summary: we’re ~0.55x coverage vs. Q3 ARR target for named midmarket segment once you apply typical conversion drag. Finance flagged a shortfall if we don’t convert at least two larger opportunities this quarter.

Asks:
- Laura: please update stage + best ETA on the three opportunities in the spreadsheet (rows 4/7/11). I want the stage to reflect current customer signal (e.g., PO requested vs. Proposal sent).
- Marcus: can you confirm pricing guardrails if we need to offer a short‑term discount or extended payment terms? Finance will need a migration plan.
- I’ll draft the microcommit asks to send to the buyer (one‑pager + MR plan) and loop Evan.

Goal: reduce runway variance by clarifying which deals are realistic this quarter vs. pushing to next. If we can clean up stale commits and lock two midmarket closes, we avoid a finance credit request.

Attachments: 2025-07-21_nexasoft_pipe_snapshot.xlsx; mutual_action_plan_draft-v3.docx

Thanks —
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pipe LiftPlaybook: stage refresh, coverage gap & finance check-in

Karthik —

Thanks for the snapshot. I updated rows 4 and 7:
- Row 4 (Acadia Health) moved from "Negotiation" -> "Proposal Sent" (buyer requested final SOW; legal review in progress). Best ETA: 08/08/2025.
- Row 7 (Summit Retail) moved from "Proposal" -> "PO Requested" (verbal ok from CIO; procurement drafting). Best ETA: 07/30/2025.

Row 11 (Clearwave) I left as "Proof of Concept" — they asked for an additional eval run and we pushed a costed plan; likely slip to September unless we agree a reduced scope.

Marcus — FYI on pricing: I captured initial concession levers (one‑time onboarding credit; 3‑month price cap) in the shared doc. If we need to move, I recommend the onboarding credit over recurring list reductions.

I’ll prep a short buyer note for Summit to push the PO over the finish line — want to keep the momentum.

- Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Enterprise Sales

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Park <evan.park@nexasoft.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, NexaSoft Finance <finance@nexasoft.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 08:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pipe LiftPlaybook: stage refresh, coverage gap & finance check-in

Evan —

Forwarding a short internal sync. High level: Redwood identified a coverage shortfall for our midmarket motion this quarter and we want to be transparent about timing and options. Two quick items where your help would materially close the gap:

1) Summit Retail (your intake contact: Julia) — Laura reports procurement is drafting the PO and we can accept an onboarding credit instead of extended net terms. Would you be able to accelerate legal review this week if we share the final SOW by EOD Wednesday? That would lock a July close.

2) Clearwave — they’re considering a shorter pilot to shorten procurement cycles. Would Nexa consider a limited pilot (30 days, capped tokens) so we can complete evaluation and feed into your internal decision? This would help pull the close into August.

Attached: mutual_action_plan_draft-v3.docx (I’ll highlight the PO + pilot options).

If helpful, Marcus can outline the concession profile we can offer without altering annual pricing materially.

Best —
Karthik

Karthik / Laura —

Thanks for the transparency and the options. Quick replies:

- Summit: I can push legal to triage the SOW — if you send the final version by Wednesday EOD, I’ll escalate to our GC and request same‑day review. We can likely sign in the week of 28 Jul if there are no major redlines.
- Clearwave pilot: Nexa is open to a 30‑day capped pilot. Finance wants a clear success metric and a nominal purchase order (we’ll do a tech evaluation PO for $1,500 to formalize it). I’ve looped finance for the PO processing cadence.

One note: our procurement team prefers limited contract concessions; the onboarding credit approach is OK as long as it’s a one‑time credit and tracked in the MA.

I’ll follow up once GC comments are back.

—Evan

Head of Platform Operations, NexaSoft
